description: This Python source file implements a text-to-speech (TTS) service class 'HathoraTTSService' that interacts with Hathora-hosted TTS models via HTTP API. It includes functions for decoding audio payloads, class definitions for input parameters and the main service, and methods for running TTS synthesis asynchronously.

classes.name: HathoraTTSService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Hathora-hosted TTS models, supporting configuration, metrics, and asynchronous speech synthesis.

classes.name: HathoraTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: A Pydantic model class for optional input parameters such as speech speed and additional configuration options.

methods.name: _decode_audio_payload
methods.description: Decodes WAV/PCM audio bytes into raw PCM frames, sample rate, and channels, with fallback for raw PCM.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HathoraTTSService with model, voice, sample rate, API key, base URL, and optional parameters.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates whether the service can generate processing metrics (returns True).

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronously performs TTS synthesis on provided text, yielding audio frames or errors.
